# LixBlogs Creator Badge Icon Prompts

This document defines the visual direction and individual generation prompt for all 25 creator badge SVGs. Save each finished asset under `public/badges/<badge-id>.svg` using the filename listed in its heading.

## Shared SVG direction

Apply this direction to every individual badge prompt:

> Create a polished creator-achievement badge for LixBlogs as clean, production-ready SVG artwork. Use a square `256x256` viewBox with a transparent background and a centered circular medallion silhouette. Use bold geometric shapes, rounded corners, consistent medium-weight outlines, and strong negative space. The symbol must remain recognizable at 30px. Avoid text, letters, numbers, photorealism, excessive detail, embedded raster images, filters, and external fonts. Keep important artwork inside a 20px safe area. Use no more than five flat colors. Include a subtle editorial and playful panda-inspired character without placing a panda in every badge. Ensure strong contrast in both light and dark interfaces. Optimize paths and provide accessible `<title>` and `<desc>` elements.

### Difficulty palette

| Difficulty | Primary accent |
| --- | --- |
| Easy | `#60A5FA` |
| Moderate | `#9B7BF7` |
| Hard | `#F59E0B` |
| Exceptional | `#EC4899` |

Supporting colors are ink `#171724`, cream `#FFF8EC`, mint `#4ADE80`, and coral `#FB7185`.

## Badge prompts

### 1. First Light — `first-light.svg`

> Design a rising sun emerging from behind the bottom edge of an open notebook. Use five broad sun rays and one small sparkling star to suggest the creator's first published story. Use the Easy blue accent with warm cream and amber details. Keep the notebook and sunrise readable as one compact silhouette.

### 2. Finding a Voice — `finding-a-voice.svg`

> Design a friendly editorial megaphone emitting three progressively larger speech waves. Place a tiny sparkle at the end of the final wave to represent a creator developing their voice across multiple stories. Use the Easy blue accent. Avoid musical notes and written characters.

### 3. Profile Complete — `profile-complete.svg`

> Design a complete profile card containing a simplified circular portrait silhouette, a small banner strip, two short bio lines, and a prominent completion checkmark. Use the Easy blue accent. Make it feel like a finished identity card rather than a generic user icon.

### 4. Topic Explorer — `topic-explorer.svg`

> Design a compass whose three primary points terminate in distinct topic symbols: a leaf, a code-bracket shape, and a small star. Use the Easy blue accent. Emphasize exploration and variety while keeping the symbols simple enough for small rendering.

### 5. Series Starter — `series-starter.svg`

> Design three stacked editorial cards connected by a single curved binding line. Give the top card a small bookmark tab and a sparkle, communicating the beginning of a connected story collection. Use the Easy blue accent.

### 6. Ten Stories — `ten-stories.svg`

> Design a substantial stack of manuscript pages arranged as a compact fan, with ten page-edge marks implied through grouped lines rather than written numbers. Add a Moderate purple ribbon wrapping around the stack to signify a writing milestone.

### 7. Prolific Creator — `prolific-creator.svg`

> Design an overflowing personal library built from many bold book spines, with a fountain pen rising from the center like a torch. Use the Hard amber accent and make the overall shape feel abundant and prestigious.

### 8. Deep Diver — `deep-diver.svg`

> Design a fountain-pen nib diving beneath stylized ocean waves toward a glowing pearl. Include layered water bands and a small depth marker without numbers. Use the Hard amber accent and communicate long-form writing, reader depth, and discovery.

### 9. Consistent Creator — `consistent-creator.svg`

> Design a compact calendar grid with four separated weeks visibly completed using small filled dots. Wrap a smooth, continuous Moderate purple orbit around the calendar to symbolize repeated and reliable publishing.

### 10. Unbroken Voice — `unbroken-voice.svg`

> Design an uninterrupted glowing waveform that loops through a circular twelve-segment ring without breaking. Include a small fountain-pen nib at the origin of the waveform. Use the Exceptional pink accent with a restrained purple secondary accent.

### 11. First Hundred — `first-hundred.svg`

> Design a central open story surrounded by a dense but orderly semicircle of reader dots. Use several dot sizes to imply the first meaningful audience milestone, with an Easy blue upward spark above the book. Do not include `100` or any text.

### 12. Reader Favourite — `reader-favourite.svg`

> Design an open book whose pages naturally form a heart in the central negative space. Surround it with a small halo of reader dots and one bookmark ribbon. Use the Moderate purple accent. Make it warm and editorial rather than a generic social-media heart.

### 13. Wide Reach — `wide-reach.svg`

> Design a globe made from curved editorial page lines, with three broadcast arcs carrying tiny story cards across different regions. Use the Hard amber accent to emphasize substantial reach and international discovery.

### 14. Headliner — `headliner.svg`

> Design a prominent story card beneath a radiant spotlight, framed by outward broadcast waves and a subtle crown-like arrangement of three sparks. Use the Exceptional pink accent. It should feel like a major audience achievement without using a literal newspaper headline or text.

### 15. Worth Saving — `worth-saving.svg`

> Design a deep bookmark ribbon inserted into an open book, with multiple smaller bookmark tabs orbiting toward it. Use the Moderate purple accent and place a small protected sparkle in the ribbon's negative space.

### 16. Shareworthy — `shareworthy.svg`

> Design one story card splitting into three clean outward paths, each ending in a small reader node. Add a forward-moving spark on the longest path. Use the Hard amber accent. The composition should communicate organic sharing rather than a generic upload symbol.

### 17. Read to the End — `read-to-the-end.svg`

> Design an open book with a visible page trail reaching a finish ribbon and bold completion checkmark. Enclose the scene in an almost-complete circular progress ring. Use the Exceptional pink accent with mint completion details.

### 18. Returning Audience — `returning-audience.svg`

> Design three reader silhouettes following a looping circular path back toward an open story. Place a small doorway-shaped page at the center, suggesting readers repeatedly returning to the creator's work. Use the Hard amber accent.

### 19. First Collaboration — `first-collaboration.svg`

> Design two contrasting fountain pens meeting at their nibs above one shared page. Create a small sparkle exactly where the nibs connect. Use the Easy blue accent. Communicate equal co-authorship rather than assistance or approval.

### 20. Creative Partner — `creative-partner.svg`

> Design three creator nodes connected by elegant editorial strokes that merge into one finished story card. Use a balanced triangular composition with the Moderate purple accent and a central shared sparkle.

### 21. Team Player — `team-player.svg`

> Design a circular group of diverse, simplified creator silhouettes around a central open publication. Connect every creator to the publication with subtle Hard amber lines, forming a cohesive team emblem rather than a crowded people icon.

### 22. Conversation Starter — `conversation-starter.svg`

> Design an open story emitting overlapping speech bubbles that expand outward into a lively discussion. Place small reader dots inside the outer bubbles and use a Hard amber spark at the conversation's origin.

### 23. Present Author — `present-author.svg`

> Design a fountain pen actively replying inside a speech bubble, with a curved return arrow connecting it to two smaller discussion bubbles. Use the Moderate purple accent. Emphasize attentive author participation and ongoing conversation.

### 24. Publication Builder — `publication-builder.svg`

> Design a publication building constructed from stacked story pages, with three creator silhouettes placing the final top page together. Add a small flag-shaped bookmark at the summit and use the Hard amber accent for the structure.

### 25. Staff Pick — `staff-pick.svg`

> Design the collection's most prestigious badge: a refined award ribbon surrounding a luminous fountain-pen nib, with a subtle panda-ear silhouette integrated into the medallion's outer crown. Add three restrained stars and use Exceptional pink, purple, cream, and ink. It must feel curated and rare without including words or initials.

## Export requirements

- Use `viewBox="0 0 256 256"`.
- Keep the background transparent.
- Do not set fixed `width` or `height` attributes.
- Do not use `currentColor`; each badge owns its palette.
- Use unique gradient, mask, and clip-path IDs if those features are necessary.
- Do not include `<text>`, `<image>`, scripts, external fonts, or external references.
- Include concise, descriptive `<title>` and `<desc>` elements.
- Expand strokes when practical and optimize redundant groups and path points.
- Test every badge at 30px, 38px, 46px, and 96px in both light and dark themes.
